name: SBU: The Last Laugh
source:
You will play as Suhn Lee, a nerdy college kid who is being recruited to find a legendary pirate ship known as The Last Laugh. 

Along the way you will make ever lasting friendships. Enemies. And lots the adult content that comes with it. 

[From [url=https://vcproductions.itch.io/sbu-the-last-laugh]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演有些书呆子气的大学生Suhn Lee，受招募去寻找一艘名为“最后一笑号”的传奇海盗船。

一路上，你会结下长久的友谊，也会树立敌人。当然，还会遇到随之而来的大量成人内容。

[译自[url=https://vcproductions.itch.io/sbu-the-last-laugh]Itch.io[/url]]
